---
applyTo: 'projects/schema/**/*.schema.json'
---

# JSON Schema Changes

Read the
[JSON Schema coding guidelines](../../docs/internal/development/coding-guidelines/json-schema.md)
before editing a published schema. Preserve version-1 compatibility unless a new
schema version and migration behavior are specified. Update the schema tests,
the `manifest-schemas` OpenSpec specification, and public schema documentation
when the contract changes.
